name: mnestic-dev
description: Development tooling for Mnestic. The extension and the Anki add-on themselves have no dependencies; this only pins what the tests use.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:addon && npm run test:listing
scripts.test:addon: python scripts/check-addon.py && python scripts/guard-test.py && python scripts/bridge-test.py
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:adapters && npm run test:e2e
